
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /switch  (/model)                          │
  │  Quick Switch Provider/Model                │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Interactively switch your AI provider and model.

  Usage:
    /switch

  Details:
    Opens an interactive menu to select a new provider (Claude, GPT-5,
    Gemini, Vertex AI, OpenRouter) and then pick a model. Requires an
    API key already configured in your .env file.

  Examples:
    $ /switch
    $ /model

  Tips:
    Tip: Use /free to instantly switch to the cheapest model.

  Related: /config  /free
